performance.compare.partial.dropped.text: {n, plural, one {# measurement dropped} other {# measurements dropped}} (a limit was full)
performance.compare.partial.dropped.note: What makes a Performance export partial, in "The baseline is partial: {what}.". Lower case.

performance.compare.partial.evicted.text: history removed for space in the range
performance.compare.partial.evicted.note: What makes a Performance export partial, in "The baseline is partial: {what}.": recorded history in its time range was removed to make room. Lower case.

performance.compare.partial.invalid.text: some of its measurements weren’t valid, so {keys} {n, plural, one {is} other {are}} unknown
performance.compare.partial.invalid.note: What makes a Performance export partial, in "The baseline is partial: {what}.". {keys} lists measures' field names (requests, responseBytes: keep them); {n} is how many. Lower case.

performance.compare.partial.projectPart.text: one project’s part of a workspace export
performance.compare.partial.projectPart.note: What makes a Performance export partial, in "The baseline is partial: {what}.": only one project's part of an export of the whole workspace is compared. Lower case.

performance.compare.partial.unattributed.text: some losses couldn’t be attributed to a project
performance.compare.partial.unattributed.note: What makes a Performance export partial, in "The baseline is partial: {what}.": measurements lost that Hive couldn't say were which project's. Lower case.

performance.providersNote.assistant.text: The Assistant’s sessions are the workspace’s, not a project’s.
performance.providersNote.assistant.note: Performance, under Provider usage for a project with the Hive Assistant chosen as whose work: why the table is empty (the Assistant isn't any project's).

performance.providersNote.scripts.text: Scripts start no sessions, so they have no provider usage.
performance.providersNote.scripts.note: Performance, under Provider usage with Scripts chosen as whose work: why the table is empty (scripts call Hive's API and run no coding agents).
